# UB Testing

> UB Testing is an independent digital product studio based in Berlin, Germany, working
> remotely with clients worldwide. The studio designs, tests, and sharpens digital products
> until every interaction earns its place.

The public site is currently a coming-soon page; the full studio experience launches in 2026.

## Practices

- **Product systems** — architecture, design systems, and the decisions that keep a product coherent as it grows.
- **Experience design** — interface and interaction design for digital products.
- **Quality engineering** — testing strategy, automation, and release confidence.

## Facts

- Name: UB Testing
- Type: Independent digital product studio
- Location: Berlin, Germany (52.5200° N, 13.4050° E)
- Area served: Germany and worldwide (remote)
- Established: 2026
- Status: Coming soon — accepting early-access enquiries
- Contact: hello@ubtesting.com
- Website: https://ubtesting.com/

- [Home](https://ubtesting.com/): studio introduction, practices, and early-access contact.
